faqs.question: What types of jewelry does Raikstore.com offer?
faqs.answer: We offer a wide range of jewelry including rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and custom pieces in gold, silver, and gemstones.

faqs.question: Is your jewelry genuine and certified?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our jewelry is certified for authenticity and quality. Certification details are provided with each purchase.

faqs.question: Do you accept custom jewelry orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer custom jewelry design services. Contact us with your ideas to get started.

faqs.question: What is your return and exchange policy?
faqs.answer: You can return or exchange items within 10 days of delivery, provided they are unused and in original packaging. Custom pieces are non-returnable.

faqs.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship worldwide. Delivery charges and estimated times are calculated at checkout.

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use SSL encryption and trusted payment gateways to ensure your information is safe.

faqs.question: How do I care for my jewelry?
faqs.answer: Avoid exposing jewelry to harsh chemicals and store them in a soft pouch or box to preserve their shine.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift packaging?
faqs.answer: Yes, all orders come with elegant gift packaging. You can also include a personalized note.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email to monitor delivery.

faqs.question: How can I contact Raikstore.com customer support?
faqs.answer: You can email us at support@raikstore.com or call us at (123) 456-7890 for any assistance.
